<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Anti-leak legislation:</strong> The Union Cabinet has approved a stricter law to curb exam paper leaks, proposing penalties of up to 10 years in prison and fines reaching ₹10 crore.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Digital governance:</strong> Prime Minister Modi marked 11 years of the Digital India initiative, highlighting its role in transforming governance and empowering citizens toward a &quot;Viksit Bharat.&quot;<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
